english.title: Move uncleared goods by means of a pipe-line not approved by the Commissioners
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), moved uncleared goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..), by means of a pipe-line that was not approved by the Commissioners for the purposes of section 24 of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979
english.legislation: Contrary to section 24(2), (5)(a) and (6) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.

english.notes:
(i) Section 24(2) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979 provides that Uncleared goods are:-(a) imported goods, whether or not chargeable with duty, which are subject to the control of any officer of Revenue and Customs as a result of Part 1 of the Taxation (Cross-border Trade) Act 2018, and in particular goods which are, or are to be, moved under section 30 of the Act; or
(b) dutiable goods moved from warehouse without payment of duty(ii) Section 24(5) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979 provides that Goods in respect of which the offence was committed shall be liable to forfeiture.
